overview: The Long March spirit remains ever vital, the economy steadied with progress in the first three quarters, and emergency rescue, AI manufacturing, and sporting breakthroughs together sketch the picture of development.

articles.title: In-Depth: Four Forces Behind the Long March Spirit
articles.summary: An in-depth feature examines the four forces embedded in the Long March spirit, reflecting its inheritance and value in the new era.
articles.detail: The in-depth column focuses on the Long March spirit, interpreting it through four dimensions of force. The report places the Long March spirit in a contemporary context, highlighting its guiding role for the new era.
articles.impact: A contemporary interpretation of the Long March spirit helps build social consensus and provides moral momentum for overcoming challenges.

articles.title: From the Epicenter in Baxing: A Hearth Fire and a Guardian's Watch
articles.summary: Dispatches from the epicenter in Baxing capture a hearth fire, a bowl of dumplings and a guardian's watch, showing the warmth and steadfastness on the frontline of rescue operations.
articles.detail: The report opens with on-the-ground accounts from the epicenter in Baxing, describing scenes of a hearth fire, a bowl of dumplings and a guardian's watch. It highlights the warm details and unwavering commitment on the disaster relief frontline. A related report captured the rescuers' refrain: "Get the trapped people out as fast as possible."
articles.impact: Frontline coverage of disaster relief spreads positive energy and underscores the importance of grassroots emergency response and humanitarian care.

articles.title: Xiongan Presents Its "City of the Future" Brand to the World
articles.summary: Xionga New Area unveils its "city of the future" image to the world, showcasing the progress of its construction and a new urban development philosophy.
articles.detail: The report focuses on Xiong'an New Area's external presentation as a "city of the future." Xiong'an is showcasing its urban construction and development achievements to the world under this flagship brand.
articles.impact: Xiong'an New Area's brand showcase is set to draw greater international attention, boosting coordinated regional development and the creation of an urban model.

articles.title: New Guangzhou Rule: E-Bikes Can Be Impounded for Repeat Offenses
articles.summary: Guangzhou introduces a new rule allowing electric bicycles to be impounded for repeated violations, tightening enforcement of road traffic order.
articles.detail: Guangzhou has issued a new rule under which electric bicycles — locally known as "dian ji" — can be impounded for repeat violations. The rule aims to intensify enforcement against e-bike traffic offenses.
articles.impact: The new local traffic rule is expected to improve urban commuting order and raise compliance requirements for the electric bicycle industry.

articles.title: Civil Service Exam Registration Closes with Over 3 Million Approved
articles.summary: Registration for the national civil service exam has closed, with over 3 million applicants passing review. The most popular position drew a competition ratio of 5,840 to 1.
articles.detail: Registration for the national civil service exam has concluded. More than 3 million applicants have passed the eligibility review. The hottest position saw a competition ratio of 5,840 applicants per opening.
articles.impact: The continued rise of the national civil service exam reflects the appeal of public sector employment and offers a window into the job market.

articles.title: Japan Accelerates Push Toward Remilitarization
articles.summary: One year into Takaichi's premiership, Japan's government is speeding ahead on the path of remilitarization, drawing regional concern.
articles.detail: Reports indicate that on the one-year mark of Takaichi's time in office, the Japanese government is advancing more rapidly in the direction of remilitarization. Commentators described the current trend as a "full-speed sprint," expressing concern over the regional security landscape.
articles.impact: Remilitarization trends heighten regional security uncertainty; neighboring parties must remain vigilant and maintain strategic resolve.

articles.title: Philippine Defense Chief's Provocations Toward China Draw Attention
articles.summary: The Philippine defense chief charges at China carrying a paper shield, with coverage depicting his provocative posture in satirical tones.
articles.detail: Reports use the metaphor of the defense chief "charging at China while carrying a paper shield" to portray his words and actions. The commentary is written with a satirical edge, criticizing the bluster behind his provocative posture.
articles.impact: Provocative rhetoric in the South China Sea undermines regional stability; concerned parties need to maintain strategic readiness and countermeasure preparedness.

articles.title: Exports Top 8 Trillion Yuan for First Time, 'New' Drivers Lead the Way
articles.summary: China's export value has surpassed 8 trillion yuan for the first time, with 'new' growth drivers emerging as the core highlight of foreign trade growth.
articles.detail: Data shows China's exports have crossed the 8 trillion yuan mark for the first time. Reports highlight the leading role of 'new' drivers, underscoring their central contribution to foreign trade growth.
articles.impact: Breaking the export threshold for the first time reflects an optimized trade structure, with emerging industries set to serve as a key pillar in stabilizing foreign trade.

articles.title: Tax Big Data Offers a Window into Q1-Q3 Economic Performance
articles.summary: Xinhua's authoritative briefing uses tax big data as a lens to examine China's economic performance in the first three quarters.
articles.detail: Xinhua's authoritative briefing column uses tax big data as an observational angle, interpreting China's economic performance over the first three quarters from a tax perspective.
articles.impact: Tax big data provides important evidence for macroeconomic assessment and helps the market form stable expectations.

articles.title: Reading the Quality of the Industrial Economy in the First Three Quarters
articles.summary: The report focuses on industrial economic performance in the first three quarters, analyzing the quality and structural highlights of industrial operations.
articles.detail: The report examines overall industrial economic performance in the first three quarters, using 'quality' as the entry point to analyze the caliber and structure of industrial operations.
articles.impact: Industrial economic performance is a key indicator for gauging manufacturing sentiment and offers guidance for investment along the supply chain.

articles.title: The Middle-Class Wardrobe Is Basically One Big Anta
articles.summary: Under the headline 'The Middle-Class Wardrobe Is Basically One Big Anta,' the report focuses on the deep penetration of domestic sportswear brands into middle-class consumption.
articles.detail: The article, titled 'The Middle-Class Wardrobe Is Basically One Big Anta,' focuses on sportswear brands and middle-class consumption trends, highlighting the deep penetration of domestic brands into middle-class wardrobes.
articles.impact: The rise of domestic sportswear brands in the middle-class market reflects consumption upgrading and growing brand strength of Chinese labels.

articles.title: AI Reshapes Manufacturing: APEC Spotlight on the Greater Bay Area
articles.summary: Coverage focuses on how AI is transforming manufacturing under the APEC framework, showcasing applications that blend wearable mechs and creative design on the factory floor.
articles.detail: Through an 'APEC in the Bay Area' segment, the report examines how AI is reshaping manufacturing. Using vivid imagery of mechs donned on the body and creativity brought to the table, it illustrates AI applications across the production chain.
articles.impact: Deep integration of AI and manufacturing will accelerate industrial upgrading and speed up the emergence of a smart manufacturing ecosystem.

articles.title: Can Stem Cell Infusions Costing Hundreds of Thousands Really Fight Aging?
articles.summary: The report questions whether stem cell infusions priced at hundreds of thousands of yuan truly deliver anti-aging effects, scrutinizing the science behind high-cost longevity treatments.
articles.detail: The report investigates anti-aging services involving stem cell infusions costing up to hundreds of thousands of yuan. It critically examines the scientific basis of such high-priced longevity consumption.
articles.impact: A science-based scrutiny of the anti-aging market can guide more rational consumer choices and underscores the need for stronger regulation and industry standards.

articles.title: Does General Anesthesia Impair Memory After Surgery?
articles.summary: A science explainer addresses whether memory declines after general anesthesia under surgery, offering the public a medically grounded reference.
articles.detail: The article uses the question 'Does memory worsen after general anesthesia?' as an entry point to respond to common public concerns about the side effects of anesthesia.
articles.impact: Anesthesia literacy helps ease patients' pre-surgical anxiety and improves public medical awareness and doctor-patient communication.

articles.title: Chinese Para-Athletes Deliver Best-Ever Asian Para Games Performance
articles.summary: China's Paralympic delegation posted its best-ever result at an overseas Asian Para Games, showcasing elite sporting prowess.
articles.detail: China's Paralympic delegation achieved its best performance at an Asian Para Games held outside China, marking a major breakthrough in para-athletics.
articles.impact: The breakthrough in para-sports is expected to further advance accessible athletics and draw greater attention from across society.

articles.title: Xu Jiayu Breaks World Record in 50m Backstroke
articles.summary: Xu Jiayu set a world record in the 50m backstroke, delivering another landmark breakthrough for Chinese swimming.
articles.detail: Chinese swimmer Xu Jiayu broke the world record in the 50m backstroke, a significant milestone in the event.
articles.impact: The world-record swim boosts China's standing in international swimming and raises the profile of the event.

articles.title: Scoliosis Weighs Heavy on Chinese Students
articles.summary: Coverage spotlights scoliosis among Chinese students, warning that the health threat is placing growing pressure on young people.
articles.detail: Under the headline "Scoliosis Is Crushing Chinese Students," reports focus on spinal health problems among students, highlighting the real pressures the condition places on this group.
articles.impact: The student scoliosis problem underscores the need to strengthen youth fitness programs and school health management.

articles.title: Southern China's Dangerous Mosquitoes Are Migrating North
articles.summary: Reports track the northward spread of disease-carrying mosquitoes from southern China, reflecting shifts in insect distribution and climate conditions.
articles.detail: With the headline "Southern China's Toxic Mosquitoes Are Migrating North in Droves," coverage examines the northward expansion of mosquito populations and its links to climate and environmental change.
articles.impact: Changes in mosquito distribution suggest public-health control measures need adjustment, while public awareness of mosquito prevention should be raised.

articles.title: Choosing the Right Flu Medication Within 48 Hours
articles.summary: An author chronicles their medication choices during the first 48 hours of the flu, offering readers a personal reference for dealing with the virus.
articles.detail: The article recounts, from a personal perspective, the first 48 hours of dealing with the flu, sharing the author's experience in choosing the "right" medication.
articles.impact: Sharing flu medication experience helps the public respond rationally during flu season, though actual use should still follow medical advice.
